tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Full-text search across aidata.stream: documentation, blog posts, changelog, pricing, FAQ and the home page. Returns the best-matching sections with a snippet and a URL (with anchor where available). Use get_page to read a whole page afterwards. English by default; pass lang for the French or German

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one aidata.stream page as Markdown. Accepts a path ("/pricing/", "/docs/getting-started/") or an absolute aidata.stream URL. Use list_pages or search_site to find URLs.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the pages on aidata.stream with title and description, optionally filtered by section (docs, blog, changelog, core) and language. Good first call to see what documentation exists.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current AI Data Stream plans as structured data: monthly and annual prices in USD, GBP and EUR, what each tier includes, trial terms, extra seat cost and sign-up links. AI usage is never billed by AI Data Stream: users bring their own AI API keys (BYOK).
